name: spatial_anchor
implementation_status_2026_05_28: MATH SUBSTRATE ACTIVE. Hardware capture layer (Web Audio API + Wi-Fi RTT API) remains TEXT-PLACEHOLDER. Synthetic-input pipeline fully tested.
summary: The bridge from screen-bound rendering to physical-world rendering. Fuses three telemetry streams — acoustic echo (ultrasonic pings → wall distances), Wi-Fi RTT + GPS (cm-precision indoor position), and GPU coordinate graph (existing Godot + Remotion + SVG embeddings) — into a single coordinate origin anchored to a physical room. The avatar knows the floor. Textures snap onto real walls. Render target IS the room.
engine_pattern: deterministic sensor fusion + coordinate transform. Acoustic time-of-arrival → triangulated wall mesh; Wi-Fi RTT → (x,y,z) within cm; merged into a 4×4 spatial transform that becomes the origin for every workflow_card render. Same crystal-chain pattern as time_vec — every spatial anchor event is a recorded crystal.

acoustic_echo_map.input: ultrasonic impulse via Meta Glasses or local transceiver
acoustic_echo_map.output: vector of distances to each detected surface (typically 4-6 walls + ceiling + floor)
acoustic_echo_map.embedding_axis: matches wave_emb shape — DCT-II of distance vector gives a 'room signature'

wifi_rtt_position.input: Wi-Fi Round-Trip-Time to nearby APs + optional GPS
wifi_rtt_position.output: (x, y, z, heading) in cm precision indoors, m outdoors
wifi_rtt_position.embedding_axis: extends time_vec — 4 scalars sin/cos encoded same way as timestamp

coord_graph.input: acoustic_echo_map + wifi_rtt_position + Godot scene transforms + SVG bboxes
coord_graph.output: unified 4×4 affine transform stack (room → scene → assets)
coord_graph.embedding_axis: geometry_crystal — same shape-family lens as SVG, but applied to room mesh

rendering_inversion.old_paradigm: draw 3D model INSIDE viewport → pixel output → screen
rendering_inversion.new_paradigm: map vector coordinates DIRECTLY onto physical room boundaries → output via WebXR / Meta Glasses HUD
rendering_inversion.code_pattern: CSS transform: translate3d(targetX_real_meters * scale, targetY, targetZ_real_meters * scale)  + rotateY(heading_real_world)

joins_existing_substrate.vector_axis: spatial_origin_hash via BLAKE3 — same retrieval pattern as moe_router
joins_existing_substrate.wave_axis: DCT of acoustic_echo distances = 'room signature' — find similar rooms past harvested
joins_existing_substrate.time_axis: spatial_anchor events get same forward/inverted sin/cos encoding as inference timestamps
joins_existing_substrate.sentence_axis: room descriptions ('living room with hardwood floor and bay window') feed sentence_chain
joins_existing_substrate.svg_axis: wall mesh exported as SVG floor plan → svg_vector_embed → geometry_crystal
joins_existing_substrate.antithesis: find rooms OPPOSITE in shape/echo signature — e.g., open-plan vs subdivided

the_two_lands_thesis: DIGI LAND = the screen, Godot viewport, browser canvas. ME LAND = physical room measured by audio + radio. The coord_graph welds them into one continuous coordinate space. Everything the Studio renders can land in either, depending on the target surface.
use_case_realestate: Friend walks into client's home → Meta Glasses fires ultrasonic sweep → wall mesh built in <2s → workflow_card mr_walkthrough renders the planned renovation (new paint, furniture placement, wall removal) directly onto her view of the real room → client sees AS-IF preview in their actual space.
use_case_avatar: Photo-to-avatar workflow renders the rigged mesh ANCHORED to physical floor (not clipping through couch, not floating). Real interaction.
guarantees: Deterministic merge — same telemetry streams + same room → same spatial_anchor crystal
Tamper-evident — every anchor event blake3-chained like inference records
Privacy-preserving — telemetry stays local; only the room signature crystal goes to network if user opts in
Graceful degradation — when Wi-Fi RTT unavailable, falls back to acoustic-only (with reduced precision)
